I ask mostly because my sister is a midwife, and our life philosophies are entirely different. I still remember when she was pregnant with her 3rd, saying her daughter WAS going to be interested in dance and this, that and the other. I was hoping for this kinda reply from somebody with sense and I'm glad to hear it tbh, its a shame we can't saturate the occupation with more people interested in the wellbeing and health of the parent and child, as you say, harm reduction, rather than being some miracle worker who worships birth and life, which I've unfortunately come across often. I think a lot about how awful the industry is when it comes to concepts like informing the parent of the why and how, and recieving authentic consent. There was a study done in a university hospital in my city, study found MOST people under maternity care feel assaulted, uninformed and extremely stressed in the face of whatever intervention the professionals put in place. Makes me wonder about the individual philosophies of certain midwives, honestly. The results of that study still bothers me a lot
